title: DLLImport couldn't find DLL in AOT
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5, 4.5.1

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7688) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-14400F (16 threads) - 31.83 GiB memory

### Issue description

When using DLLImport to import external libraries (In my case, LuaJIT). It works while testing, but fails to import in debug/release builds. This issue seems to be specific to Windows. It does not happen on Linux. (untested on macOS)

I've also noticed that it does copy to the data folder. But dll search seems to be looking at the root of the folder (the same place .exe file is in). It does work when .dll is copied to the root folder.

The error:
```
ERROR: System.DllNotFoundException: Unable to load DLL 'LuaJIT.dll' or one of its dependencies: The specified module could not be found.
   at System.Runtime.InteropServices.NativeLibrary.LoadLibErrorTracker.Throw(String) + 0x6f
   at Internal.Runtime.CompilerHelpers.InteropHelpers.FixupModuleCell(InteropHelpers.ModuleFixupCell*) + 0xfd
   at Internal.Runtime.CompilerHelpers.InteropHelpers.ResolvePInvokeSlow(InteropHelpers.MethodFixupCell*) + 0x2f
   at TestLua.luaL_newstate() + 0x24
   at TestLua._Ready() + 0x1d
   at Godot.Node.InvokeGodotClassMethod(??? method, NativeVariantPtrArgs args, godot_variant& ret) + 0x6b3
   at dll-aot!<BaseAddress>+0x4cd7de
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new C# project
2. Import any external .dll
3. Modify .csproj to include the following:
```xml
<Project Sdk="Godot.NET.Sdk/4.5.1">
	<PropertyGroup>
		<PublishAot>true</PublishAot>
		<AllowUnsafeBlocks>true</AllowUnsafeBlocks>
	</PropertyGroup>
	<ItemGroup>
		<TrimmerRootAssembly Include="$(TargetName)" />
		<TrimmerRootAssembly Include="GodotSharp" />
		<None Include="LibraryName.dll" Condition="'$(GodotTargetPlatform)' == 'windows'" CopyToOutputDirectory="Always" Link="LibraryName.dll" />
	</ItemGroup>
</Project>
```
4. Write any code that includes the use of `LibraryImport` or `DllImport`
5. Export the project & Run

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[DLL_AOT.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23161420/DLL_AOT.zip)
